# gsm_image_registry_credential (Data Source)

Reads a project or environment image registry credential.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "gsm_image_registry_credential" "token" {
  project_id = "<project_id>"
  name       = "game-images"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the credential
- `project_id` (String) Project ID where the credential belongs

### Optional

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID. Set it to read an environment credential.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `auth` (List of Object) Authentication methods. Each entry sets exactly one of `token` and `aws_ecr`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--auth))
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `registry_url_pattern` (String) Registry URL prefix that the credential applies to, e.g. `123456789012.dkr.ecr.ap-northeast-2.amazonaws.com`. Wildcards are not allowed.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>

Optional:

- `default` (String)
